title.zh: ⚡️国际刑警逮捕HEX和PulseChain创始人Richard Heart
title.en: ⚡️国际刑警逮捕HEX和PulseChain创始人Richard Heart

current_state.zh: Richard Heart在伊斯坦布尔被捕，资产被扣押，涉嫌国际欺诈网络调查中；HEX代币因该消息下跌近30%，市值蒸发约1.6亿美元。
current_state.en: Richard Heart arrested in Istanbul, assets seized, investigation into alleged international fraud network ongoing; HEX token fell nearly 30% and erased about $160 million in market value following the arrest reports.

updates.title_zh: ⚡️国际刑警逮捕HEX和PulseChain创始人Richard Heart
updates.title_en: ⚡️国际刑警逮捕HEX和PulseChain创始人Richard Heart
updates.what_changed_zh: 据报道，土耳其国际刑警组织逮捕了HEX和PulseChain创始人Richard Heart。
updates.what_changed_en: Turkish Interpol reportedly arrested HEX and PulseChain founder Richard Heart.
updates.current_state_zh: 据报道，土耳其国际刑警组织逮捕了HEX和PulseChain创始人Richard Heart。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Turkish Interpol reportedly arrested HEX and PulseChain founder Richard Heart.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Turkish Interpol reportedly arrested HEX and PulseChain founder Richard Heart.

updates.title_zh: Richard Heart在土耳其被捕，距国际刑警组织红色通缉令发布已近两年
updates.title_en: Richard Heart arrested in Turkey almost 2 years after Interpol red notice
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道确认Richard Heart在伊斯坦布尔被捕，并补充： coordinated raid by Istanbul authorities, seizure of $4 million cash, 64 luxury watches, weapons, computers, crypto mining equipment; investigation into alleged international fraud network; Finland Interpol Red Notice from Dec 2024 context.
updates.what_changed_en: New report confirms Richard Heart was arrested in Istanbul and adds: coordinated raid by Istanbul authorities, seizure of $4 million cash, 64 luxury watches, weapons, computers, crypto mining equipment; investigation into alleged international fraud network; Finland Interpol Red Notice from Dec 2024 context.
updates.current_state_zh: Richard Heart在伊斯坦布尔被土耳其当局协调突袭逮捕，资产被扣押，涉嫌国际欺诈网络调查中。
updates.current_state_en: Richard Heart arrested in Istanbul in a coordinated raid by Turkish authorities; assets seized; investigation into alleged international fraud network ongoing.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Richard Heart (Richard James Schueler), the Hex founder wanted by Finland under an Interpol Red Notice, was arrested in Istanbul in a coordinated raid that seized $4 million in cash, luxury watches, weapons, and crypto mining equipment.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Richard Heart (Richard James Schueler), the Hex founder wanted by Finland under an Interpol Red Notice, was arrested in Istanbul in a coordinated raid that seized $4 million in cash, luxury watches, weapons, and crypto mining equipment.

updates.title_zh: HEX代币卖家在创始人Richard Schueler被捕报道后抛售1.6亿美元
updates.title_en: HEX token sellers erase $160M following reports of founder Richard Schueler arrest
updates.what_changed_zh: HEX代币价格下跌近30%，市值蒸发约1.6亿美元，市场对创始人被捕消息做出反应。
updates.what_changed_en: HEX token price fell nearly 30%, erasing about $160 million in market value, as market reacted to reports of founder's arrest.
updates.current_state_zh: Richard Heart在伊斯坦布尔被捕，资产被扣押，涉嫌国际欺诈网络调查中；HEX代币因该消息下跌近30%，市值蒸发约1.6亿美元。
updates.current_state_en: Richard Heart arrested in Istanbul, assets seized, investigation into alleged international fraud network ongoing; HEX token fell nearly 30% and erased about $160 million in market value following the arrest reports.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: HEX fell nearly 30% and shed about $160 million in market value after Turkish media reported the detention of founder Richard Schueler (Richard Heart) in Istanbul.
updates.detailed_summary_en: HEX fell nearly 30% and shed about $160 million in market value after Turkish media reported the detention of founder Richard Schueler (Richard Heart) in Istanbul.
